misc.text: The time has come to show Sony just how dissatisfied we are with several recent decisions—specifically, the end of physical game production for PlayStation consoles. This decision directly impacts players by limiting their freedom and choices; this move affects not only collectors but also publishers, retailers, and even those who have fully switched to digital. So, join this movement today. #PSBlackout #PS4 #PS5
